collections.name: EmbeddingStore
collections.description: Persisted semantic vectors for MO, BriefFacts, Acts, Sections, victim narratives, and officer notes. Used for ANN-style semantic retrieval without recomputing embeddings.

schema.source_type: enum: mo | brief_facts | act | section | victim_narrative | officer_note

collections.name: ModelArtifactManifest
collections.description: Manifest of model artifacts stored in Stratus, including scalers, encoders, graph snapshots, embeddings, and metadata.

collections.name: KnowledgeGraphSnapshot
collections.description: Time-versioned graph snapshots for gang evolution and association drift.

collections.name: CrimeIntelligence
collections.catalyst_service: Catalyst NoSQL + Catalyst QuickML + Catalyst Zia AutoML
collections.description: Per-FIR intelligence document containing risk, severity, repeat-offender, gang, MO, hotspot, prediction, anomaly, and confidence scores.

schema.model_outputs: object keyed by dbscan | isolationForest | xgboost | sentenceTransformers | networkx
schema.explainable_ai: object with prediction, why, importantFeatures, historicalCases, confidence, recommendedAction

collections.name: InvestigationGraph
collections.description: Interactive link-analysis graph derived from CaseMaster, Accused, Victim, Unit, Employee, ActSectionAssociation, ArrestSurrender, and ChargesheetDetails.

schema.nodes: array of Accused | Victim | Police | Location | Vehicle | Phone | Weapon | Case | Organization nodes
schema.edges: array of Family | Financial | Call | Vehicle | Same FIR | Same MO | Same Address | Same Gang edges

collections.name: RepeatOffenderProfile
collections.description: Derived accused intelligence calculated from the official Accused table and related CaseMaster records.

collections.name: GeoIntelligenceLayer
collections.description: Karnataka map overlays for heatmaps, hotspot clusters, risk overlays, replay frames, and deployment recommendations.

schema.layer_type: enum: heatmap | hex_cluster | prediction | risk | deployment | digital_crime_twin

collections.name: CopilotConversation
collections.description: English/Kannada AI copilot sessions with citations to FIR source records and generated findings.

schema.messages: array of user | assistant | system messages

collections.name: ModelArtifact
collections.catalyst_service: Catalyst QuickML + Catalyst Zia AutoML + Stratus
collections.description: Model metadata for XGBoost, Isolation Forest, DBSCAN, KMeans, Random Forest, NetworkX, PageRank, Sentence Transformers, Prophet, and LightGBM outputs.

collections.name: SignalInbox
collections.description: Alert and workflow event queue for crime spikes, gang movement, repeat offenders, anomalies, high-confidence predictions, and officer overload.

schema.source: enum: fir | forecast | risk | anomaly | network | copilot | report
